overall_summary: The call highlighted strong ad revenue growth in Europe and the rest of the world at 24%, a 16% revenue increase driven by infrastructure costs, a 23% rise in R&D spending, and early promising performance lifts in pre‑launch tests. However, the company noted rising legal costs, a slight employee headcount decline, a 30% drop in Facebook feed engagement, performance‑related employee reductions, and a modest slowdown in pricing growth. Overall sentiment was predominantly neutral (70.9%), with positive sentiment at 26.6% and negative at 2.5%.
